about.title: Who I am, in one paragraph
about.manifesto: Five years shipping software across hospitality, finance, energy, and data — most of it where the back end and the UI meet. I write strict TypeScript, lean on contracts over comments, and design systems that survive the second feature.

duration.yearsMonths: {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} and {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}

hotelgest-2025.summary: Building features for a hotel management product used by independent hotels.
highlights: Full-stack delivery across the booking and operations surface.
Iterating on internal tools and data flows alongside product.

andbank-2024.summary: Engineering on banking systems in a regulated environment with strict release discipline.
highlights: Worked across services with strong type contracts and code review.
Operated under banking-grade auditability and change control.

eosol-software-manager-2023.summary: Led the software function inside an energy engineering group — hiring, planning, and delivery.
highlights: Owned roadmap, scoping, and architecture decisions across internal apps.
Mentored developers and aligned engineering with operations.
Shipped TypeScript stacks on top of legacy data systems.

eosol-software-developer-2022.summary: Designed and shipped full-stack features for the internal engineering platform.
highlights: Moved core flows onto a typed Node + React stack.
Replaced ad-hoc scripts with maintainable services.

eosol-data-engineer-2021.summary: Built the data ingestion and reporting backbone for energy operations.
highlights: Stood up ingestion and transformation pipelines for operational data.
Modelled storage to make downstream reporting predictable.

upna-research-2020.summary: Research on big-data processing infrastructure and storage migration.
highlights: Built a Hortonworks-based pipeline with Sqoop, Hive, and Kafka.
Restructured a NoSQL database and migrated it to MySQL.
Wrote a backend in Express.js to expose the new schema.

apidex.name: apidex
apidex.summary: Local-first OpenAPI playground. Upload a JSON or YAML spec and get a clean, navigable view of every operation; share specs via S3 + DynamoDB with an optional password.

andllar.name: andllar
andllar.summary: Real-estate marketplace for Andorra. Listings, agency promotions, and map-based search with full multilingual support across English, Spanish, Catalan, and French.

sowify-admin.name: Internal admin suite
sowify-admin.summary: Tailor-made internal admin and ERP suite. Invoicing with PDF generation and email delivery, expense tracking, CRM (leads, partners, investors), contacts, role-based access, and dashboards on a type-safe tRPC + Prisma stack.
